background: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. is the main operating bank of JPMorgan Chase, the largest bank in the United States, serving consumers, businesses, corporates and institutions across the country and worldwide.
synthesis: Ratings are AA from Fitch, AA- from S&P after the upgrade on 15 Nov 2024 and Aa2 from Moody's, all stable. Capital is strong, with CET1 of 15.0% and leverage of 7.5% both in the top quarter of US banks, though CET1 has fallen 0.5 points since 30 Jun 2025. No liquidity ratios are held here for the bank, and nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. Ratings and capital point the same way, and both are strong.
